about_the_game:
Something has gone horribly wrong. Main and emergency backup power has gone out in Site 97, leading to a facility-wide containment breach. The staff is trapped, and alone in the dark, with the creatures and people they kept locked up. Players will need to work together to get the power back on and find supplies to ensure their survival. It's kill or be killed, now.

Features

  • Numerous weapons of different types to find

  • Procedural level layouts to ensure unpredictability and replay value

  • Multiple playable factions

  • Multiple SCP monsters to fight and run from

  • Proximity voice chat

  • Public and private game servers

And much more coming post-launch!

content_descriptors.notes: SCP: Fractured Reality's gameplay involves disturbing horror sequences, as well as blood and gore.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-bit required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-bit required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 (7th generation or newer) or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: SCP: Fractured Reality is a co-op VR horror shooter set in the SCP universe. Players must work together—as well as against each other—to survive the many horrors lurking in Site 97’s depths.
